rules.statement: Amendments to a pleading were permissible where they sought to elucidate title without widening the scope or altering the character of the action, and did not affect pleas such as prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: By the amendment the plaintiffs were not seeking to widen the scope or alter the character of the action. No new cause of action was averred.
